items.q: Maybe that's where I met Leonard; could be.

ctx.x: There's a tour that Leonard Fether went on the bus with at one point; I thought that was in '36, that should have been the time that you were in the band.

You played in New Orleans with Louie; that was the first time you ever played New Orleans.
